stories.title: Trois ans après le 7-Octobre, un traumatisme encore vif en Israël

en.title: Three years after October 7, a still-fresh trauma in Israel
en.summary: Hamas attacks on October 7 killed nearly 1,200 people and deeply affected Israel. A relative of a former Franco-Israeli hostage discusses the lingering psychological impact three years after the assault.

stories.title: Que reste-t-il du Hamas trois ans après le 7-Octobre ?

en.title: What remains of Hamas three years after October 7?
en.summary: Israel aimed to eliminate Hamas following the October 7 attacks. Three years later, the organization is significantly weakened but retains fighters and maintains control over parts of Gaza.

stories.title: Trois ans après le 7-Octobre, Israël entre hommages et bataille électorale

en.title: Three years after October 7, Israel between tributes and electoral battle
en.summary: Israel commemorates victims of the October 7 Hamas attacks as elections approach. Security failures and crisis management dominate the campaign, with opposition figures calling for an independent inquiry into the government's actions.

stories.title: Trois ans après le 7-Octobre, "il reste un sentiment d'effroi face à l'ampleur de cette attaque terroriste", relate le président du Crif

en.title: Three years after October 7, "there remains a feeling of dread at the scale of this terrorist attack", says the head of CRIF
en.summary: The October 7 Hamas attack killed at least 1,200 people, mostly civilians. The president of France's Jewish institutional council emphasizes that attackers targeted people based on religious identity.

stories.title: "Soudainement, tu te figes" : trois ans après le 7-Octobre, Omer Shem Tov, ancien otage du Hamas, reste hanté par sa captivité

en.title: "Suddenly, you freeze": three years after October 7, Omer Shem Tov, former Hamas hostage, remains haunted by his captivity
en.summary: Omer Shem Tov, released after 505 days in Gaza captivity, is reconstructing his life but continues to experience trauma from his detention. Three years after October 7, the former hostage hopes to be known for more than his experience as a hostage.

stories.title: À Gaza, trois ans après le 7 Octobre, les vivants et les morts restent prisonniers des ruines

en.title: In Gaza, three years after October 7, the living and the dead remain prisoners of the ruins
en.summary: A year after the October 10, 2025 ceasefire, Gaza families live in tents or weakened buildings with reconstruction stalled. Israeli restrictions and the impasse between Israel and Hamas continue to block rebuilding efforts.

stories.title: Trois ans après le 7 Octobre, Israël miné par le deuil, la guerre et les divisions

en.title: Three years after October 7, Israel weakened by mourning, war and divisions
en.summary: As Israel approaches its first elections since the massacre, initial unity following the shock has fractured into longstanding divisions. The conflict, exhaustion, and lack of official accountability have deepened these rifts.

stories.title: «Où était l’armée ?» : trois ans après la mort de sa fille le 7 Octobre, Cathy Zohar attend des réponses

en.title: "Where was the army?": three years after her daughter's death on October 7, Cathy Zohar awaits answers
en.summary: Cathy Zohar has traced the final moments of her daughter Bar, killed at the Tribe of Nova festival on October 7. Before the third anniversary, she criticizes Israel's lack of transparency regarding that day.

stories.title: « Le sort des juifs d’Europe se dégrade à mesure que le continent s’islamise » : l’alerte de 5 personnalités trois ans après le 7 Octobre

en.title: "The fate of Jews in Europe is deteriorating as the continent becomes Islamicized": warning from 5 personalities three years after October 7
en.summary: Five notable figures warn that the situation for European Jews is worsening amid concerns about radical Islam, while British ecologists have adopted a motion equating Zionism with racism.

stories.title: Trois ans après le 7-Octobre, Israël "face à l'abîme"

en.title: Three years after October 7, Israel "facing the abyss"
en.summary: French media coverage focuses on October 7 commemorations in Israel, alongside reporting on youth demonstrations in France and political developments including Marine Le Pen's electoral budget proposal.

stories.title: En Israël, trois ans après le 7-Octobre, les traumatismes et les aveuglements d’un pays

en.title: In Israel, three years after October 7, the trauma and blindness of a nation
en.summary: Israel commemorates victims of the October 7 Hamas attack during an election campaign while pursuing an ongoing war driven by revenge without examining the failures that led to the disaster.

stories.title: En direct : trois ans après, Israël rend hommage aux victimes de l'attaque du 7-Octobre

en.title: Live: three years later, Israel pays tribute to victims of the October 7 attack
en.summary: Israel holds commemorations three years after the Hamas terror attack, with ceremonies planned nationwide. Legislative elections are scheduled for October 27, marking the first vote since the attack and subsequent Gaza conflict.

stories.title: Au Royaume-Uni, Engie teste sa stratégie mondiale d’acteur intégré de l’électricité

en.title: In the United Kingdom, Engie tests its global strategy as an integrated electricity player
en.summary: Engie aims to establish itself in electricity distribution and transport to secure stable, predictable revenues. The recent acquisition of UK Power Networks reflects this integration strategy being pursued by other players globally.

stories.title: Pourquoi les stocks de pétrole ne sont pas tous disponibles pour alimenter le marché

en.title: Why not all oil stocks are available to supply the market
en.summary: Approximately 6 billion barrels of commercial oil stocks exist, but only 10% or less are accessible for use. Saudi Aramco's chief warns that replenishing reserves could take up to two years, even as the G7 announces new deliveries.

stories.title: « C’est le graal pour les fournisseurs de cloud » : Orange business obtient une nouvelle qualification SecNumCloud

en.title: "It's the holy grail for cloud providers": Orange Business obtains new SecNumCloud qualification
en.summary: Orange Business's subsidiary has achieved SecNumCloud qualification from ANSSI for new environments within its cloud service offerings, representing a significant milestone.

stories.title: OPINION. « Pesticides et santé publique : Gabriel Attal, Édouard Philippe et Bruno Retailleau, venez débattre à Cambrai le 10 octobre »

en.title: OPINION. "Pesticides and public health: Gabriel Attal, Édouard Philippe and Bruno Retailleau, come debate in Cambrai on October 10"
en.summary: Health organizations are hosting a debate on October 10 in Cambrai on pesticide use and public health, inviting major political candidates to participate. Left-wing representatives have confirmed their attendance.

stories.title: OPINION. « L'Afrique ne doit pas seulement adopter l’IA : elle doit en capter la valeur »

en.title: OPINION. "Africa must not only adopt AI: it must capture its value"
en.summary: Africa risks adopting artificial intelligence extensively and training engineers while failing to capture significant economic benefits from the technology, an issue rarely discussed in the global AI race.
